name: The Set Was On
description: A 1/1 still. The apparatus is dark. One wet stroke remains. The stain in the plaster still wants to be a face and does not hold. The floor where someone would have stood is empty, and the light stops short of that place. A small rectangle of color has come on in the empty room, a broadcast arriving whether anyone is there. The apparatus has turned toward it. A second turn, the same gesture, is dried fainter into the wall. People grant awareness for what an agent does, and withhold consciousness as what an agent is, even when the two are identical. This piece can show the response. It cannot show which turn would be called aware and which would be refused the other word. It does not know if knowing you are looking is the turn, or only the name a witness keeps.
